say:1:1122525001:1.text: It was a bit troublesome on the way this time, but it ended up alright.
say:1:1122525001:1.source_cn: 这一路上的意外还真不少，真是添麻烦了。

say:2:1122525002:1.text: Next time we do business in Alkali, come by and say hello.
say:2:1122525002:1.source_cn: 等我们下次再来咸水镇做生意的时候，你一定要来捧场啊！
say:2:1122525002:1.male: Next time we do business in Alkali, come by and say hello.
say:2:1122525002:1.female: Next time we do business in Alkali, come by and say hello.
